accounting: Charge validation, observation, canonical map, retained events, projection, features, pending receipt, readout weights and scratch to each arm. Report deep Python peak bytes and separate wire bytes. Record train/evaluation/replay event visits, projection visits, prediction/update route visits, and process CPU seconds including instrumentation. No hidden reference computation, global scans, matrix operations, gradients or GPU.
encoding: Canonicalize route identity by first appearance using only history. Ordinal channel=24*position+rank. Gap channel=2280+256*position+gap. First/last/count channels=26600+3*rank+[0,1,2] with values 1/(first+1),(last+1)/95,count/95. Histogram uses only count channel. Bias=26672. Ordinal/gap/joint include their named channels, all strength 1. Every arm observes the complete bounded history. joint_shuffled uses joint encoding.
execution: This protocol authorizes input-only audit now. Implement and regression-test matched learners and durable exclusive started/completed receipts before one-shot scoring. Hash protocol, implementation, input audit and Python version in reservation. Existing reservation blocks retries. Store successful final research weights only under models/research; reports under workspace/evaluation.

gates.integrity: All input audit checks, budgets, frozen evaluation weights, receipt identity/time tests and final-weight prediction replay must pass.
gates.mechanism: Every seed: joint Brier improves >=0.01 over first_last_count and joint_shuffled in both families; improves >=0.01 over gap for middle_order and ordinal for gap_order. Blind opposite-mode predictions must be exactly equal.
gates.quality: Every seed/family: joint accuracy >=0.90 and Brier <=0.20.
gates.strong_reference: Report joint against ordinal on middle_order and gap on gap_order. No superiority claim unless joint improves Brier >=0.01 in every seed of that family; component adoption does not require redundant features to beat the sufficient non-spiking reference.

generator: For each seed/split/family use SHA256(seed:family:pair) to rank route pool by SHA256(key:route), select four routes, and choose suffix repetition by key[0] modulo 2. Append alternating third/fourth routes with unit gaps. Both modes share suffix and total duration. Pair order is reversed if key[1] is odd. IDs and targets stay evaluator-only. Separate readout per family and seed.
scope: Synthetic middle-order and gap local-learning comparison; shared explicit memory, no spike-benefit claim
shuffle: Training only: joint_shuffled receives independently SHA256-ranked, exactly balanced labels across all episodes in each family/seed; freeze permutation before training. Evaluation uses true labels. No pair ID, mode, seed, family, suffix choice or source route ID is a readout input.
stop_rule: Any failed integrity or budget check blocks scoring. Preserve failed quality/mechanism results without retuning this identity. Fresh seeded route-disjoint synthetic inputs are not independent real evidence. Do not reopen completed electricity, shared-observer or sealed real-data tests.
